_comment: SHIPPED authored maps: terrain, tactical zones, deployment and per-Task layers in one document, in the same shape the map editor exports (mapeditor.ts CustomMap). This is how an authored map reaches multiplayer: it lives in data/ rather than one browser's localStorage, so every client resolves the identical board. Author a map in the editor, Export it, and drop the file's map object in here with an id and a name.
_shape: maps[] = { id, name: {en}, grids?: 12|16|18, pieces: TerrainPiece[], zones: [{id,name,cells:[{col,row}]}], deploy: {black:[],white:[]}, objectives?: [{kind,zone,col,row}], tasks?: { [missionId]: { zones?, objectives?, deploy? } } }
_note: grids is Large Grids and ABSENT MEANS THE PRINTED 12x12. Zone cells are LARGE-GRID coordinates; objective col/row are SUBCELLS. Task layer keys must be real mission ids from missions.json - mapeditor.test.mjs pins that.
